seed.description: random seed: another number picks other buildings along the same roads

items.description: content path of a spline asset (no extension)

roads.description: roads the buildings line (both sides of every path of each spline)

model.description: the building (usually the model generated from a .building.json); its +Z side faces the road; content path of a model asset (no extension)

weight.description: how often it is picked compared to the others

buildings.description: buildings picked at random by weight along the roads

setback.description: distance from the road edge to the building front (sidewalk); unit: m

gap.description: space between neighboring buildings; unit: m

area.description: only build inside this polygon [[x, z], …]; unset builds along the whole network

spacing.description: grid step of the points tried inside the blocks (jittered); unit: m

maxDistance.description: only this far from the nearest road; unit: m

fill.description: after the street front, fill the blocks: points nearest the roads first, each building facing the nearest road
